fragen.frage: In which order does Hermes get a new tool?
antworten: Read the list → install (with checksum) → register with Hermes and restart
fragen.erklaerung: First find out, then install properly, then register with Hermes – and restart Hermes.

fragen.frage: Hermes edited a PDF and says “Done!”. What do you do?
antworten: Open the file and check it yourself
Ask Hermes whether it's sure, and believe it
fragen.erklaerung: People stay in control: always look at results yourself.
